faq.q: What types of ultrasound do you offer?
faq.a: We offer portable and fixed ultrasound machines with various probe configurations. All devices are CE certified and ISO 13485 compliant.

faq.q: Are blood pressure monitors medically certified?
faq.a: Yes, all our monitors are Class IIa medical devices, CE certified with ESH protocol validation.

faq.q: Do you provide training on how to use the equipment?
faq.a: Yes, a basic training session is included with every purchase. Advanced training is available as an option.
